_source: Places put on another OpenBible record's point (pipeline/build_data.py, move_points). OpenBible calls each of these 'another name for' the other record, but resolves the two one hop apart, to different candidate sites (docs/crosswalk/their-errors.md, O6): one place, one point. Checked by hand on 2026-10-19.

ac17675.why: Dimonah (Josh 15:22) is Dibon of Judah (Neh 11:25), in the Negeb list of Josh 15:21-32; OpenBible's resolution lands on Dibon of Moab, 63 km away.

a92de65.why: Bethul (Josh 19:4): another name for Bethuel, which sits with Bethel 2 at Khirbet el-Qaryatein; resolved to Bethuel's second candidate, 23 km west.

acf2fac.why: Chesil (Josh 15:30): another name for Bethuel; the same resolution as Bethul.

ae83efa.why: Canneh (Ezek 27:23): another name for Calneh 2, resolved 74 km from it.

a061538.why: Zer (Josh 19:35): another name for Madon, resolved 31 km from it.

a6c0a5f.why: Ir-moab (Num 22:36): another name for Ar, resolved 9 km from it.

ad259d1.why: Sea of Jazer (Jer 48:32): another name for Jazer, resolved 11 km from it.

a5c4318.why: Hukok (1 Chr 6:75): another name for Helkath, resolved 8 km from it.

ab049cf.why: Ramoth of the Negeb (1 Sam 30:27): another name for Ramah of the Negeb (Josh 19:8), resolved 34 km from it.
